stops.title: Mufoɔ ne nnwuma nhyehyɛeɛ
stops.caption: Hwan na ɔsom, ne berɛ bɛn.
stops.speech: Adwumakuo kora wɔn a wɔsom wɔ mu din ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ hwan na ɔsom berɛ bɛn, a wɔyi adi nnawɔtwe kakra ansa.

stops.title: Adwumayɛfoɔ pɛ
stops.caption: Abisadeɛ, nsɛmmisa, nsɔhwɛ.
stops.speech: Adwumayɛfoɔ pɛ firi abisadeɛ kɔ nsɛmmisa ne deɛ wɔde ma kɔsi nsɔhwɛ berɛ, a obiara wɔ ne gyinaberɛ so.
